ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE

   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
